items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I did play a few gigs with a couple of the be-boppers, Dizzy and Charlie. In fact I recorded with Dizzy and Charlie.

ctx.x: How did -- how did that music strike you
Well, I thought it was something different, and I went right along with it because I did play a few gigs with a couple of the be-boppers, Dizzy and Charlie. In fact I recorded with Dizzy and Charlie.
